infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Duna uses the camera when you record a game with Duna Vision, take a profile photo or, if you choose, broadcast a match live.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Duna uses the microphone only when you choose to record a game with sound or broadcast a match live.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Duna lets you choose photos for your profile and videos from your library to add to your private film archive.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Duna reads only the Apple Health categories you choose to build private, personalized Readiness, Sleep and Strain trends, compare those patterns with your matches, and align heart rate with your Duna Vision recordings.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Duna does not write to or change Apple Health. HealthKit access is read-only so you can choose the data behind your private performance timeline, personal insights and video overlays.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Duna uses only the contacts you pick to find partners you already play with or to send a one-time game invitation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Duna uses your location to show courts, clubs and games near you. If you choose Share trip ETA, Duna shares only a short-lived distance and arrival time with your coach before a session.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Only after you choose Share trip ETA, Duna keeps your arrival time on the Lock Screen current in the background. It stops on its own 30 minutes after the session starts and never stores your raw location.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Duna reads the phone's tilt while you record so the court stays level and the score overlay sits upright. Nothing about your movement is stored.
